The '''Dolsan system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Dolsan]].
